about: Targets for node/cluster_route.py, in order of preference. Named by ssh alias only: no addresses, keys or credentials belong in this file. vm102 is the CI runner VM (runner containers, so a heavy job waits while a CI job runs there). r620 and r710 are Proxmox hosts with no docker: a job runs in a mktemp directory as nobody and is removed after. They ship disabled; enabling one is a local override file (CLUSTER_ROUTE_TARGETS) after the staged ssh alias exists, see node/ci/stage_cluster_targets.ps1.
